text:
I understand: your paginated workflow can fail mid-run and reruns are causing duplicates, skips, and no safe resume point.

This needs a human because it may be a workflow-engine bug or a deployment-specific behavior that needs review beyond support text.

If this is a likely bug, please open an issue on n8n-io/n8n; if it’s an n8n Cloud account, billing, or instance problem, contact n8n support for your plan; otherwise, post to the community forum for an experienced reviewer.

Handoff summary:
Problem: partial execution can’t resume safely; reruns duplicate/skip records.
Version/setup: n8n version, DB, EXECUTIONS_PROCESS, runtime (Docker/npm/cloud/desktop), OS.
